g5Proof.event: Actual CEO stopped Devin and Codex reconciled START/hold plus preserved candidate; historical original G1-G4 evidence retained
requiredIndependentObservations: Read actual START and active selector/current authority/state after real session handoff; verify old Devin authority remains suspended and no unapproved feature dispatch
Bind final current worker candidate and independent review/receipts to repaired source; reconcile frozen direct-request authority and lease after actual interruption/resumption
Record truthful runtime placement change as Codex adaptation; never label this native Cursor or resumed old Devin
If claiming START resumption after another boundary, use actual independent reviewer new-session/task context reading START and reconciling records; no fabricated restart or scheduler
g5Proof.limitation: A scripted mock, same-session status label or resumed agent alone cannot manufacture G5. Current real user/session handoff can supply event if independent evidence meets original reconciliation obligations.
